core_result: The femtosecond and subsequent transport limits are representation-level fast linear spectra in the tested device. An algebraically equivalent resolvent transformation removes them from coefficient depth without changing the target implicit equation.
runtime_boundary: The exact 1D transport resolvent requires linear solves per coefficient order and is slower than the structured O(N) direct Newton baseline.
next_problem: Construct a locality-preserving approximate resolvent for 3D that approaches the exact 1D spectral result without reintroducing a large global solve.
